sentence: This project studies how building features affect evacuation for people who rely on mobility aids during disasters.
This project works on quantum computing topics such as quantum machine learning, quantum software testing, quantum protocols and compiler optimization.
This project studies whether plasma waves can directly accelerate light and how much the wavelength of light can be shortened.
This project brings nursing and engineering together to work on healthcare problems such as medical errors, patient care plans and the design of medical devices.
This project tries to find out how proteins get to sites of replication and work together to copy DNA that folds into four-stranded quadruplexes.
This project studies how flower structures vibrate when bees buzz and how those vibrations release pollen.
This project builds a way to make organic color centers on single-walled carbon nanotubes using DNA templates and laser-based refinement to place them precisely.
This project studies turbulence, the chaotic motion of fluids and plasmas, and builds machine-learning methods that obey the laws of physics.
This project studies how wildfires change soil microbial communities and how the soil recovers in agricultural, rangeland and unmanaged ecosystems.
This project treats the training of deep neural networks as a feedback control problem so that they can be made safe for spacecraft.
This project studies how warm temperatures trigger genes that change how plants grow, and the transcription factors that control this.
This project studies how the way beadwork is designed shapes its mechanical properties, using experiments and predictive models.
This project designs algorithms and systems that train large foundational models on supercomputers faster and at larger scale.
This project studies how tundra soil microbes use nitrogen as shrubs spread across the Arctic, by measuring the proteins they make.
This project studies what data modern vehicles collect about drivers and builds tools that help people understand and control how it is shared.
This project works on biological materials and biological processes in chemical and biological engineering, such as drug delivery, gene editing and probiotics.
